item.title: French far-left candidate Mélenchon demands ‘thorough overhaul’ of Germany ties
item.description: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader of the hard-left France Unbowed (LFI) party, on Friday declared he was "hostile" to German economic liberalism and its dominance of the European Union. The septuagenarian presidential candidate in the 2027 race also warned that France could be drawn into unwanted conflict as Germany's growing military strength makes it a "target" for other countries.

item.description:
🇫🇷 ⚽ 🇧🇬 At least 11 supporters of Bulgarian football club #LevskiSofia were injured in Marseille on Thursday, as skirmishes broke out between the visiting club and fans of hosts Olympique Marseille (#OM) before their Europa League fixture,
FRANCE 24 has the details.

item.title: Paris Paloma tackles Greek mythology, generative AI in her second album 'The Fatal Flaw'
item.description: Dheepthika Laurent chats with Paris Paloma on set ahead of her Paris concert. The UK singer-songwriter and guitarist is promoting her second album, "The Fatal Flaw", an ode to Greek mythology, art and feminism. She tells us why this album is more personal than her first record, "Cacophony".

item.title: France is dealing with water insecurity – a new study shows it's a global problem
item.description: Tens of thousands of people in France are living under water restrictions as the country deals with a drought despite recent rains, according to the environment ministry. But this is a global problem, as a new study released Wednesday revealed "the largest global decline in surface water resources recorded" since 1991, when data collection began.

item.title: Big EU defence projects under threat from proposed budget cuts: Commissioner Andrius Kubilius
item.description: We speak to the EU's Commissioner for Defence and Space, Andrius Kubilius. The former prime minister of Lithuania – who grew up during the Soviet era – tells us how he sees the confrontation between Europe and Russia. He also sounds the alarm over proposed cuts in the EU's future budget, saying that they could jeopardise major European projects in defence and space. Kubilius praises the EU's SAFE defence loans programme, remarking that it has been "really very successful".
